name: ChatWise AI Guide
author: westexcel

sections.description:
ChatWise AI Guide lets you turn your website into a smart customer service assistant. It uses the power of OpenAI’s GPT technology to respond to questions from your visitors using your own business content.

Perfect for small businesses, local services, and solopreneurs — no coding needed!

Key features:
– Embed a chat box on your site
– Add your business details or FAQ content
– Connect your own OpenAI API key
– Visitors ask questions and get relevant, AI-generated responses
– Lightweight, easy to use, no 3rd-party SaaS required

Why ChatWise?
Many AI chatbots are bloated or expensive. ChatWise is designed for simplicity and control — you provide the content, you manage the API key, you stay in control.

Upgrade to Pro (optional):
– Customize chat box appearance (tone, colors)
– Add tone control (e.g. friendly, professional, casual)
– Minimize or restore chat box visibility
– More features coming soon!

External services

This plugin connects to the OpenAI API (https://platform.openai.com/) to generate AI-powered responses for your website visitors.

When a user interacts with the chat widget, the plugin sends the user’s question, your provided business/FAQ content, and your OpenAI API key to the OpenAI API. No personal user data is sent unless included in the chat message. Responses are generated by OpenAI and displayed to the user.

Use of the OpenAI API is subject to OpenAI’s terms of use and privacy policy:
– https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
– https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your WordPress site or install directly from the plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings > ChatWise AI Guide in your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Paste your OpenAI API key (get one at https://platform.openai.com)
  5. Enter your business information or FAQ content.
  6. The AI assistant will now appear on your site for visitors to chat with!
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI account?

Yes. You’ll need an OpenAI account and a secret API key. You pay OpenAI directly based on usage.

Is this plugin free?

Yes, the base version is completely free and open source. Some advanced features are available in the Pro version.

How does the plugin use my business info?

Your input (FAQ or business details) is used to construct prompts sent to the OpenAI API. The assistant answers questions based only on the information you provide.

Where do I get an OpenAI key?

You can create one here: https://platform.openai.com/account/api-keys
